items.title: David Spinozza interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, NY, September 27, 2025
items.q: the producer, I think John Simon was like, “Shut up, Spinozza, just play the part.”

ctx.x: And it’s really funny because I guess the producer knew that the studio musicians weren’t going to tolerate playing this song over and over again for a lot so he rehearsed Don McLean for weeks by himself with his bass player, and then he called me and Paul Griffin, the piano player, to be the two studio guys on the record. So when we get there we’re running it down, I’ll never forget this, and I say to Don McLean, “You know you really should cut out some verses. This is really too long. This will never get on the…
And that tune has some odd measures in it every once in a while.
